product_updates.title: Anthropic’s annualized revenue surges to $65B
product_updates.content: The model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in two months.

product_updates.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
product_updates.content: "We have some really ambitious plans to help you work with AI in Chrome to get things done, and I’ll have more to share soon," Jacob Bank, Relay founder and CEO, said.

product_updates.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
product_updates.content: Rare books are incredibly valuable for training LLMs, since these models have already trained on whatever's available online.

product_updates.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
product_updates.content: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as the former AI chipmaker pivots to a neocloud business and expands its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.

product_updates.title: Nvidia investing $1.5B in SoftBank data center developer behind OpenAI project
product_updates.content: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer will guarantee its chips power an OpenAI data center.

product_updates.title: Wispr raises $280M at $2B valuation as it looks beyond dictation
product_updates.content: The funds will allow Wispr to increase its footprint as it ventures into new areas, such as meetings, with its newly released note-taker tool.
